text: 利率降至1%！股票回购增持再贷款降息，阶段性安排转为长期制度 利率降至1%，改善宏观资金价格信号，使低成本资金更顺畅地流向有真实回购需求的企业。
text_en: Interest rate cut to 1%! Relending for stock repurchases and increased shareholdings cut, phased arrangement becomes long-term institutional arrangement. The rate is cut to 1%, improving the macro funding price signal and allowing low-cost funds to flow more smoothly to companies with genuine repurchase needs.
